title: Can Claude replace Kissflow? 20/20 checks, 9 spec gaps #shorts
description:
Claude built a Kissflow alternative, a purchase approval workflow, from one written spec: all 20 acceptance checks passed, and the build exposed 9 gaps in the spec.

Full build test (2:31): https://youtu.be/dGUBA36TJ9g
The free spec: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/blueprints/approval-workflow
Kissflow pricing and alternatives: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/alternatives/kissflow

Made with AI: Sam's on-camera hook and outro are an AI avatar of him, and the narration is his AI voice clone (HeyGen). The product footage is from the real test build.

Music: "Chill Wave" by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com). Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License, http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
